subject: Hudl, Veo and Tracab
text:
Hi [NAME],

First off congratulations on the EA acquisition! My previous startup was
acquired a couple years back and despite some challenges, it was a great
time.

I wanted to connect as we've been working with a lot of players in your
space (Veo, Hudl, Spiideo, MVP) and would love to understand more about
Tracab and your views on data curation/annotation. Veo saved $650k in
engineering time by working with Encord and Hudl, MVP broke through their
scaling platforms using our video native rendering.

Is the world of data curation / annotation / testing something you're
focusing on and would you be interested in trading notes over a call next
week?

subject: lip syncing - working w/ flawless, synthesia and captions
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you're hiring MLEs and Research Scientists for generative models and
face tracking so I thought to reach out. We work with Flawless, Synthesia
and Captions to develop their computer vision models for very similar use
cases: lip syncing and video generation. Thought it might be a good time to
chat!

For context - We're a computer vision data development platform of choice
for over 200 AI teams. We've tailored our workflow for generative AI teams
with video-native data curation & annotation and advanced face-tracking
annotation capabilities.

Curious how you're thinking about developing your CV features, and happy to
share our perspectives from working within the space. Let me know if you're
open to a quick chat Tuesday to Friday next week?
